$comment: Corrections of tools/walk-tones.py, figure by figure: skin colours to add or drop (hex; a dropped colour is never skin), boxes [left, top, right, bottom) of the 128-pixel frame where the skin's colours are not skin (not) or the only ones where they are (only), a fifth item "head" for a box that moves with the head, places of the skeleton in only (head, hands, upper-arms), open to leave out thin lines of the skin's colours, single pixels {frame: [[x, y], ...]} that are skin (pixels) or not (not_pixels), and span, the part of the tone's ramp the skin takes.
